plugins.name: Spotify
plugins.description: Now playing and synced lyrics from Spotify Desktop, right below your notch.

website.name: Spotify for Island
website.summary: Synced lyrics and Spotify playback in a little space at the top of your Mac.
website.description: Keep the current lyric beside your work. Spotify for Island follows the Spotify Desktop app through macOS Automation, with synced lyrics from LRCLIB and NetEase. No additional Spotify login is needed. The bundled plugin uses the compact strip; the expanded preview shows another renderer layout.

features.title: Lyrics that keep time
features.description: A synced line follows your playback position. Availability depends on lyric providers and track matches.

features.title: Your desktop session
features.description: Connect through macOS Automation. Keep using Spotify Desktop with the account you already have.

features.title: Playback within reach
features.description: Pause, skip, or go back through the plugin and native companion controls. Keyboard input works while the plugin has focus.

previews.label: Compact
previews.alt: Compact lyric strip with playing bars and original sample text
previews.caption: Default bundled layout · original sample content from the real renderer.

previews.label: Expanded
previews.alt: Expanded renderer sample with synced lyrics and playback controls
previews.caption: Renderer example · the bundled plugin currently uses the compact strip.

plugins.name: Agent Pulse
plugins.description: Claude Code, Codex, and Grok status at a glance. Know when an agent needs you.

website.name: Agent Pulse
website.summary: Your coding agents, one glance away.
website.description: Follow Claude Code, Codex, and the official Grok CLI using local lifecycle hooks. See working sessions, permission requests, and ended turns without opening every terminal. Connect once, then review the hooks in Codex.

features.title: Know when you are needed
features.description: Permission requests and supported questions appear ahead of working sessions.

features.title: Three agents, one view
features.description: Main sessions from Claude Code, Codex, and the official Grok CLI. Open a session in Codex, or copy a CLI resume command from the secondary menu.

features.title: Local status only
features.description: No transcript scanning, prompt collection, API keys, or remote status service. Additive setup preserves existing hooks.
